description: P, PI, PD, PID, and 2-DOF configurations of one implementation.
implementation_notes: Implemented in the generic C API and exposed through a thin named wrapper. The application still supplies validated typed configuration and maps ControlIR ports to wrapper arguments.

manual_actions.message: Populate the typed UCON configuration from ControlIR design values, connect graph input/output ports to the generated wrapper, and verify units, sample time, limits, and anti-windup tracking before target use.
